title: Glowing scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura behind scooter -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='38' fill='#1a2a44' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='11' fill='#2b3d5c'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='11' fill='#2b3d5c'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='74' r='5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- deck / footboard -->
  <rect x='26' y='58' width='44' height='9' rx='4' fill='#ff7fbf'/>
  <rect x='26' y='58' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffc0dc'/>
  <!-- frame connecting deck to front -->
  <path d='M66 62 L78 50 L82 52 L70 64 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x='76' y='30' width='6' height='26' rx='3' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='68' y='26' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='29' r='4' fill='#ff7fbf'/>
  <circle cx='91' cy='29' r='4' fill='#ff7fbf'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='40' r='5' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- deck top highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='59' width='36' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffe6f2'/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 22 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <path d='M88 18 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 Z' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
</svg>
